rules: One manifest declares exactly one release; this lock admits one release.
A release is exact: no range, versions array, floating tag or implied major.
latest, next, canary, nightly and every other dist-tag or range never decode into a release.
Activation reads the resolved installed version of @angular/core, never the declared range.
An installed version that is not an admitted exact release is unsupported-version and is never coerced.

upstreamPeerFacts.note: Recorded upstream fact, not a Verter pin. The oracle runs on the repository's pinned ts-js engine (typescript 6.0.3, tests/sfc-projection/STP1/products/engine-matrix.json), which satisfies it. Editor TS-region answers come from tsgo, never from this oracle.

featureSources.use: grammar, recovery and type-check corpus inputs for ANG1, ANG6 and ANG9; expected outputs are written from these official sources
angular.dev guide examples for the feature corpus and the documented semantics of the admitted profile

excludedReleases.reason: unpublished: on 2026-10-09 the npm registry lists no 23.x version of @angular/core or @angular/compiler-cli (dist-tag next is 22.3.0-next.1). No exact version can be named, and pinning the channel would be a floating tag.
excludedReleases.readmission: An explicit exact-release lock amendment and a separate release manifest naming an exact published 23.0.0 next or rc version with sources and reviewed integrity pins, once the major is announced. Each manifest admits exactly one release; never append Angular 23 to this manifest as a second release or profile. FWA1 then reads the separately admitted release table. Until then an installed 23.x is unsupported-version.

excludedReleases.channel: stable and prerelease builds of 22.x other than 22.2.1
excludedReleases.reason: A release is exact (VID0 R04, R06). 22.2.2 (published 2026-10-08) and the 22.3.0 next builds are not admitted; each needs a re-pin of this lock.
excludedReleases.readmission: A lock amendment that replaces the admitted exact release.

excludedReleases.reason: Legacy majors are out of scope (framework-common Versions).
No canary or nightly is admitted (framework-common Versions).

excludedModes.construct: a component declared in @NgModule({ declarations: [...] }), and any declarations array
excludedModes.reason: Legacy compilation mode (ruling 2). Only standalone components and their imports scope are admitted.

Superseded by the built-in control flow. The official migration is `ng generate @angular/core:control-flow` (adev/src/content/reference/migrations/control-flow.md at v22.2.1). Verter never rewrites it itself.

admittedModes.construct: a custom *dir attribute, for example *appRepeat="let x of xs"

divergedPins.reason: Names a legacy major that is not an admitted release.
divergedPins.resolution: ANG9 re-pins the scenario to angular@22.2.1 (ANG9 Surfaces). Until then the row is never evidence for any cell.

lintProfileAlignment.note: LNG1 names the same @angular/core and @angular/compiler-cli 22.2.1 release and a 23 next/rc channel. Lint packs run only where FWA1 admits a reviewed exact release, so the 23 channel stays inactive until an explicit exact-release lock amendment and a separate release manifest admit it. This manifest retains its single admitted release.
